name: Disable Page Combining
description: Disables memory page combining to reduce background deduplication work and lower CPU overhead.

description_i18n.en: Disables memory page combining to reduce background deduplication work and lower CPU overhead.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Zusammenführung von Speicherseiten, um Hintergrund-Deduplizierungsarbeit zu reduzieren und den CPU-Overhead zu senken.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la combinaison des pages mémoire pour réduire le travail de déduplication en arrière-plan et diminuer la charge du processeur.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The tweak uses the MMAgent API to disable memory page combining This changes system behavior by stopping background deduplication of identical data blocks in physical memory
